item.title: Show HN: Open-Sourcing It
item.summary: I have open-sourced www.cockroach.fyi Built this for myself and when I showed it to a friend, they wanted to use it as well, so I deployed it to a live domain. Didn't know so many people from across the world would be using it without me spreading it actively. And that wasnt the goal either but seeing so much love, i want others to improve it as needed I am pretty occupied with a lot of work these days, so if anyone wants to improve the project or run it for themselves, feel free to access it! The idea is to help the startup community across the globe, the more we collaborate, the better we make our and others' lives. Add your contributions or run locally: https://github.com/HamzaBinMubeen/cockroach.fyi Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49297604 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
